canada.title: Manitoba Shared Health's chief medical officer resigns, citing 'demands of the role,' work environment
canada.summary: Dr. José François submitted his resignation as provincial chief medical officer to Shared Health on Tuesday, citing "the demands of the role" and "the challenges of the work environment."

canada.title: Homicide unit investigating after 70-year-old man found dead inside Winnipeg home
canada.summary: Winnipeg police are investigating after a 70-year-old man was found dead in a home in the city's North End area earlier this week.

canada.title: Developer pitching subdivision outside Shubenacadie gets earful
canada.summary: An open house about a proposed subdivision that could bring dozens of homes near the Shubenacadie Wildlife Park started with the proponent informing area residents that construction could theoretically start at any time.

canada.title: Wolf attack in northern Saskatchewan injures contractor
canada.summary: A person suffered non-life-threatening injuries after being attacked by a wolf in northern Saskatchewan earlier this week, the province's community safety ministry has confirmed.

canada.title: U.S. price-fixing case advances against Canadian frozen potato giants
canada.summary: New Brunswick’s McCain Foods Limited and J.D. Irving-owned Cavendish Farms were among five defendants seeking the case’s dismissal.

canada.title: Inquest into death of Regis Korchinski-Paquet set to continue
canada.summary: A coroner’s inquest into the death of a Toronto woman who fell from a highrise balcony in the presence of police is set to resume this afternoon after adjourning early on Thursday.

canada.title: Workshop in Haines Junction teaches fish canning and connects generations
canada.summary: A fish-canning workshop in Haines Junction, Yukon, helps residents preserve food while also passing knowledge between generations. Participants say the skills can help reduce food waste, save money and keep cultural traditions alive.

canada.title: 25 years after project first began, final stretch of Team Gushue Highway is opening Friday
canada.summary: Twenty-five years after construction started, the Newfoundland and Labrador government says the final phase of the Team Gushue Highway is opening Friday.

canada.title: Molly Carlson’s iceberg dive earns applause but also a safety advocate’s warning
canada.summary: Canadian cliff diver Molly Carlson recently made history off the coast of Newfoundland, becoming the first woman to dive off an iceberg. Lifesaving Society Ontario spokesperson Stephanie Bakalar wants people to remember Carlson is a professional with a team and don’t try this at home.

canada.title: Warnings out for widespread wind, potential precipitation in Sask.
canada.summary: Halloween decorations may be taking flight in Saskatchewan, with wind gusts projected to reach up to 100 km/h in some areas.

canada.title: National security strategy to address array of threats coming soon: Carney adviser
canada.summary: OTTAWA - A senior federal adviser says the Liberals are poised to release a new national security strategy — the first such policy in more than two decades.

canada.title: Sentencing delayed a week for man who murdered, dismembered wife
canada.summary: A man who was set to be sentenced next week for murdering and dismembering his wife will instead be sentenced in early November.

canada.title: Snowfall warnings issued for northeastern Alberta
canada.summary: Up to 40 centimetres of snow and "damaging" winds are in the forecast for parts of Alberta.

canada.title: Penticton mayor-elect says he looks forward to tackling public safety, fiscal responsibility
canada.summary: Penticton's new mayor-elect says he is ready to roll up his sleeves and get to work on several key issues.

canada.title: Advocates point to contributions, not costs, of newcomers in Alberta referendum aftermath

canada.summary: Living more than 200 kilometres from the site of a major artificial intelligence data centre proposal isn't stopping Michael McCluskey from voicing his opposition to the project.

canada.title: More Hamilton voters cast advance ballots this municipal election than in 2022
canada.summary: Hamilton has surpassed the total number of advance ballots cast during the 2022 municipal election, with less than a week remaining before election day.
